note: CP-OS takes no analyst submission and no source. Nothing here is a submit payload: these are the input recipes of the refusal tests, each applied to a clone of the named closed run.

receipts.s1a_positive: receipt of the closed S1a positive run (acceptance A1) and its publication directory
receipts.s1a_gap: receipt of the closed S1a gap run (A2)
receipts.s1a_blocked_cp1a: receipt of the A3b clone of the positive run
receipts.s1a_refused_cp1a: receipt of the A3c clone of the positive run

verifier_refusals.recipe: receipt copy with only 'participant' changed to a different string; store and audit unchanged
receipt copy with the CP-1A SettledHead status 'restricted' -> 'accepted', and audit/receipt.sha256 rewritten to the forged receipt's content hash so the seal agrees
verifier_refusals.targets: owner_workflow._verify head check: _settled(store, module) not in receipt.heads

verifier_refusals.recipe: present the positive receipt with the gap run's store
verifier_refusals.targets: owner_workflow._verify first check: run, pack and snapshot hash differ

cpos_refusals.on: s1a_positive page and proof, s1a_gap receipt and store
cpos_refusals.recipe: verify_navigation with a proof built for the positive receipt against the gap receipt (both verify). Differs in run, pack, snapshot, heads and receipt hash at once, on purpose; receipt_hash_only isolates the hash
page with the CP-2 entry removed from report-data modules (nav untouched), page_sha256 in the proof rewritten to the forged page's hash
page whose report-data nav CP-1A row reads glyph 'pass', word 'Pass' (modules untouched), page_sha256 rewritten consistently
page with a trailing newline appended (rows and targets intact), page_sha256 rewritten
the valid s1a_positive proof with only proof.receipt_content_sha256 replaced by content_hash() of the seal_edit receipt copy; page, store and the verified receipt unchanged
the valid s1a_blocked_cp1a proof with only the CP-1A NavigationRow has_output changed false -> true; page unmodified, page_sha256 genuine
the valid s1a_positive proof with only the Model destination href '#CP-1' changed to '#CP-MODEL' (a route that exists, so no dead link); page unmodified, page_sha256 genuine
the valid s1a_positive proof with only proof.external_links changed from ('calculation.json',) to ('evil.json',); page unmodified, page_sha256 genuine. Replayed variant: external_links = ()
unmodified page, proof.page_sha256 replaced by 64 zeros

full_proof_equality: After the four prefixed diagnostics, verify_navigation requires proof == derived_proof in full (every field); any remaining difference raises cpos_proof. Proof forgeries below leave the page unmodified and its page_sha256 genuine.
